Identity.History: The Sasanian Empire arose in AD 224 when Ardashir I overthrew the Parthians and restored a centralized Persian monarchy. Its rulers built a powerful state centered on Zoroastrianism, heavily armored cavalry, fortified cities, and long-distance trade. For four centuries the Sasanians were Rome and Byzantium’s greatest eastern rival, before exhausting wars and internal turmoil left the empire vulnerable to the Arab conquests of the 7th century.
